instruction: We are going to start inside a garage. If we turn to our left, we are going to see the garage door. We are going to turn slightly right and we would see a hallway. We are going to walk toward that hallway. We should se a painting on the left side of that wall. Let's take a right, right in front of the painting. We should be now be entering a bedroom. Proceed toward the back of the chair that is in the middle of the two beds. Now that we are right in front of the back of that chair, in the middle of the two beds, looking at a painting and a desk with two lamps on it, that would be your destination.
